visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of eight young adults, five males and three females, cluster together for a high-angle group selfie at an outdoor swimming pool. They wear summer clothing and swimwear, smiling and making peace signs towards the camera. The background features a curved pool, palm trees, and a clear blue sky under bright natural light. (2) A man in a white tank top and a woman in a white cardigan and denim shorts pose together by the poolside. A splash transition occurs, and they are shown underwater. The man smiles and waves while the woman makes a face, both submerged in the clear blue water with bubbles rising. (3) A second duo, a man with blonde hair and a woman with long black hair, pose above water before transitioning below. Underwater, the woman's long hair drifts across both their faces, and they squint their eyes while trying to maintain a smiling expression. (4) A woman in a black bikini top and a man in a black tank top pose. After the transition, they are seen at the bottom of the pool. The man strikes a 'cool' pose with his hands while the woman places her palms together in a prayer-like gesture, looking at the lens. (5) Two men, one wearing a vibrant orange shirt and the other in a black tank, pose confidently. Submerged, they strike dramatic poses, though bubbles escape from their noses, adding a comedic element to their attempt at looking serious. (6) The first couple returns for a final sequence. As they submerge, a visual filter transforms them into blonde-haired mermaids with shimmering golden scales and tails. The environment changes to a more stylized, AI-generated underwater scene with clear sunlight rays piercing the surface.
